summary: Foresight Autonomous Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its November 12, 2026 press release announcing completion of the integration of its 3D perception system into VisionWave's VARAN modular unmanned ground vehicles for defense applications. The work follows an August 2026 Strategic Cooperation Agreement covering mechanical design, system-level integration, and stereoscopic calibration of visible-light and thermal sensors; next steps target an Autonomous Stack software package. Live demonstrations for ministries of defense in Europe, Asia, and North America are planned. No financial terms, ownership changes, or capital transactions are disclosed; this is an ordinary product/collaboration update.
